entities.summary: Oleh Oleksiyovych Dyomin is a Soviet and Ukrainian politician and diplomat, a former Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of Ukraine to the Russian Federation, Ambassador of Ukraine to the People's Republic of China.
